prompt: Challenge C145-CH1: Our adtech platform inserts pre-roll ads into podcast episodes, but the targeting is purely demographic; click-through rates are stuck at 0.

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research applies hedonic regression to measure price premiums for AI-generated contextual signals in programmatic advertising, finding a 22 percent CPM premium for granular contextual targeting over standard category signals.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08915","field":"abstract","quote":"hedonic regression to estimate the price premium associated with AI-generated contextual signals"}]},{"text":"Work uses conjoint analysis to quantify media buyer preferences for targeting attributes, demonstrating that audience targeting capability accounts for 61 percent of attribute importance in banner placement valuation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08905","field":"abstract","quote":"choice-based conjoint (CBC) analysis to estimate the implicit prices that media buyers attach to specific attributes"}, {"id":"SYN-PUB-08905","field":"abstract","quote":"placement position (above versus below the fold) and audience targeting capability together account for 61 percent"}]},{"text":"Expertise in discrete choice modelling and media inventory valuation applied to programmatic and display advertising contexts, with collaboration on data pipeline infrastructure.","sources":[{"id":"R0820","field":"bio","quote":"discrete choice modelling applied to the valuation of digital media inventory—including display, video, and programmatic"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has published directly on quantifying the value of contextual targeting signals in programmatic advertising [SYN-PUB-08915] and has established methods for measuring how targeting attributes influence ad performance and pricing [SYN-PUB-08905, SYN-PUB-08913], precisely addressing the challenge of building and valuing content-context matching for ad placement optimization."}
